title: accordion block props
description: Panels (« Panneaux »): titled items the learner opens one by one, in four presentations of the same items: accordion (panels that open in place, the default), tabs (one panel at a time under a row of tabs; an accordion in narrow containers), cards (a grid of flip cards: the title and the image in front, the text behind) and stack (the flip cards one at a time, with Previous and Next). Revealing content is not practice (guardrail B2): follow it with a question when the learner must remember it.
x-ai-instructions: Use panels for optional or parallel detail the learner may read in any order, not for the main thread of a page nor for content to compare side by side. Choose accordion for 3 to 7 independent sections a learner picks from (long bodies, phones); tabs for 2 to 5 parallel facets of one subject with short labels (one or two words, 24 characters at most); cards for a few terms or claims to recall before turning over (a front of a few words, a back of one to three sentences: write prompt to say what to think of first); stack for a short series of cards seen one at a time. Switching presentation keeps the items: write titles and bodies that work in all four. Give an item an image only when it carries information (alt says what), and keep bodies to a few sentences (about 120 to 270 characters).

presentation.description: accordion: panels that open in place (allowMultiple: several at once); tabs: a row of tabs, one panel shown at a time in the room of the tallest (an accordion in containers narrower than 560 px); cards: a grid of flip cards, title and image in front, text behind (two columns on phones); stack: the flip cards one at a time, with Previous, Next and where the learner is.

prompt.description: What to think about before opening or turning over (above the panels): « Before you turn each card, say what you think it means. »

id.description: Stable id of the item: its visited state, translations and conversions name it.

title.description: The panel's title, the tab's label, the card's front (tabs: 24 characters at most).

markdown.description: What the panel shows once opened (the back of a card).

image.description: An image of the item: on the front of a card, at the top of a panel.

alt.description: What the image shows. Required with image; an empty alt ("") marks it decorative.

focus.description: Where the subject of the image is, kept in view when a card crops it.

allowMultiple.description: accordion: allow several panels open at once.

hint.description: cards and stack: show « Turn the card over » on each card (else only its button's name says it, for screen readers).
